total_portfolio.source: JPMorgan Chase Consumer & Community Banking 2024 Annual Report

total_exposure_billions.formula: Total Portfolio × Average Exposure per Business
total_exposure_billions.notes: Estimated based on industry benchmarks and Chase business banking loan characteristics

avg_exposure_per_business.formula: Weighted average of loan sizes across product types
avg_exposure_per_business.calculation: Term loans ($100K-$500K) + Lines of credit ($50K-$500K) + SBA 7(a) ($500K-$5M) weighted by prevalence
benchmark_sources: PPP average loan sizes: $81K-$120K by state
avg_exposure_per_business.notes: Conservative estimate reflecting that 94.9% of all small business loans are under $100K

portfolio_growth_rate_yoy.formula: (Current Year Customers - Prior Year Customers) / Prior Year Customers
portfolio_growth_rate_yoy.source: JPMorgan Chase 2024 Consumer & Community Banking report
portfolio_growth_rate_yoy.value: 10% year-over-year growth in small business clients

pre_qualified_count.formula: Total Customers × (1 - Delinquency Rate - High Risk Rate - Watch List Rate)
pre_qualified_count.adjusted_calculation: Applied industry benchmark of 65% pre-qualified rate
pre_qualified_count.notes: Industry benchmark: 60-70% of SMB customers are pre-qualified for credit products

pre_qualified_rate.benchmark: Industry standard 60-70% for established business banking portfolios

at_risk_count.formula: Total Customers × (Delinquency Rate 30+ + Watch List Rate)
at_risk_count.notes: Includes 30+ day delinquent accounts and watch-listed customers

offer_potential_billions.formula: Pre-Qualified Count × Average Offer Size × Acceptance Rate

revenue_opportunity_millions.notes: NIM of 3% is based on JPMorgan Chase firmwide NIM of 2.91% with commercial lending premium

avg_credit_score.formula: Weighted average across credit score distribution
avg_credit_score.notes: Score range 0-100 representing creditworthiness in Lumiq system

high_risk_0_40.calculation: 8% based on commercial loan charge-off rates and industry benchmarks
high_risk_0_40.notes: Reflects businesses with significant credit challenges or startups

medium_risk_40_55.calculation: 22% estimated from approval rejection rates (56% rejected/partially approved)
medium_risk_40_55.notes: Businesses requiring enhanced monitoring or with limited credit history

low_risk_55_70.notes: Established businesses with solid payment history

prime_70_plus.notes: Businesses with excellent credit, strong financials, and long banking relationships

net_charge_off_rate.source: Industry benchmark: Business loan charge-off rate 0.50% (Oct 2024)
net_charge_off_rate.notes: JPMorgan Chase maintains strong credit quality below industry average

assumptions: Total small business customer base: 7 million (confirmed from JPMorgan Chase 2024 Annual Report)
Average exposure per business: $50,000 (conservative estimate based on Chase's business loan products and industry data showing 94.9% of loans under $100K)
Portfolio growth: 10% YoY (confirmed from Chase Consumer & Community Banking 2024 report)
Pre-qualified rate: 65% (industry benchmark for mature business banking portfolios)
Net charge-off rate: 0.5% (industry benchmark for business loans, Oct 2024)
Delinquency rate 30+: 2.5% (estimated from commercial loan performance data)
Delinquency rate 90+: 1.0% (estimated as ~40% of 30+ delinquencies)
Watch list rate: 1.5% (standard commercial banking risk monitoring threshold)
Net interest margin: 3.0% (based on JPMorgan Chase firmwide NIM of 2.91% with commercial premium)
Offer acceptance rate: 60% (industry benchmark for targeted pre-qualified offers)
Average offer size: $50,000 (aligned with average exposure to maintain portfolio composition)
Credit score distribution: Estimated based on approval rates (44% full approval), rejection patterns, and charge-off data
Geographic concentration: California as top region at 22.3% (largest small business market)
Industry concentration: Professional Services at 18.5% (largest segment in SMB banking)
Single largest borrower: 0.8% (well below regulatory limit of 10% of capital)
Approval timeline: 5 business days (76% of banks approve small loans within this timeframe per FDIC 2024 survey)
Approval rate: 44% (full approval rate from 2024 small business credit survey)
Line of credit utilization: 52% (industry standard for business lines of credit)
Average interest rate: 8.83% (midpoint of Q2 2024 small business loan rate range 5.75%-11.91%)
Total loan portfolio allocation to business banking: ~24% of JPMorgan Chase's $1.47T total loans = ~$350B
Allowance for credit losses: 2% of total exposure (industry benchmark for commercial portfolios)
Coverage ratio: 2.0x (allowance / at-risk exposure, indicating strong reserve position)
